subject: ARLO SEO — Monthly — August 2026
html:
ARLO SEO — Month 2 Review (August 2026)

Covering 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-31, reported 2026-09-01.

Honest frame, stated up front: askarlo.app is a 2-month-old domain (SE Ranking Domain Trust 5, up from 4) on a 6–12 month organic ramp. Per 12-week-strategy.md's own KPI ladder, Month 2's job was still leading indicators — first measured SERP positions, early top-50 entries, off-page link acquisition, human blockers cleared — not leads. Measured against that bar, not a revenue number, this month missed on the metrics that were actually supposed to move.

Leads / CPL (GA4 conversions, proxy metric)

Pending — unchanged from Month 1. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) has been firing since 2026-07-04, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 Reporting API access, so conversion counts can't be pulled from here. By design this stays a non-goal until pages are actually ranking (per the strategy doc's own frame) — but it's worth flagging that a human checking the GA4 console directly costs a few minutes and would finally close a 2-month-old "pending."

What's working

  • Content production held pace and quality for a 2nd straight month. 6 net-new indexable pages (Google Business Profile connector, 5 blog posts — how-to-set-up-a-claude-mcp-server, client reporting, agency churn, MCP server security, Google Ads reporting) plus 3 correctness/depth sessions on already-live pages (OG/Twitter/schema fix across all 15 destination pages, comparison-table expansion + dateModified across all 15, an on-page keyword retarget on the Search Console connector page) — 9 build-gated sessions total, zero shipped regressions, every one verified via a clean npm run build.
  • The connector matrix and comparison hub are both still fully caught up with everything currently unblocked by catalog.ts — the routine is not sitting idle for lack of ideas, it's genuinely out of human-independent page-building work in those two engines.
  • Two sessions found and fixed real bugs rather than just adding volume: the Aug 24 session caught wrong-page OG/Twitter meta and mismatched WebPage schema shipping on all 15 destination pages since launch (sharing any of those pages showed the wrong title/description), and the Aug 31 session caught a connector page targeting an 8x-smaller keyword variant than the one actually gaining search volume — both diagnosed from live data, not guessed.
  • Domain Trust ticked up 4 → 5 and Google indexing shows positive (index_google: 1) — the domain is being crawled and treated as legitimate even without a human ever completing the GSC sitemap submission.

What's not working

  • Zero rank movement for a full second month. Average position across all 22 tracked keywords sat flat at 100 (SE Ranking's not-ranked floor) on every single day from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-01 — not one keyword entered the top 100 at any point this month, let alone top-50. Month 2's own target was ≥15 of 22 measured and ≥3 of the lowest-KD terms in the top 50; actual is 0 and 0.
  • Off-page link acquisition did not move at all. Live pull this session: still 2 backlinks / 1 referring domain, still the same futurlabs.dev sister-site link from Month 1 — identical numbers to the 2026-08-01 report. Off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) remains at 0 of 6, now overdue since Week 4 of the plan (roughly 2026-08-01) — two full months with no off-page work shipped, and this sandbox has no outbound HTTP to self-serve any of the six listings.
  • All three human-decision blockers set as Month 2 goals are still open, unchanged, at month's end. catalog.ts: meta_ads is now 4+ months past its own May 2026 ETA, shopify 5+ months past its April 2026 ETA, hubspot/mailerlite both past their July 2026 ETAs — and as of today mailchimp's August 2026 ETA has now also passed with the entry still coming_soon, the first time every single gated connector in the catalog is simultaneously overdue. The dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04) are both still unresolved — GSC submission has now been an open ask for 2 full months.
  • AI-engine visibility (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/AI-Overview) is still completely flat — brand presence null, link presence 0, AI-opportunity traffic 0, average position null, unchanged from every prior pulse. The GEO/AEO investment (FAQPage schema, llms.txt, structured connector pages) has nothing measurable to show yet.

Numbers vs. Month-2 targets (set 2026-08-01)

KPIMonth-2 targetActualStatus
Measured SERP positions≥15 of 22 tracked keywords (baseline, any position)0 of 22 — avg position flat at 100 every day, 2026-08-01–09-01❌ Not met
Top-50 entries≥3 of the lowest-KD terms (mcp connector, client reporting, agencyanalytics/whatagraph alternative)0 — nothing has entered top 100, let alone top 50❌ Not met
Off-page Phase 1Referring domains 1 → 6+ via 6 directory/registry listingsStill 1 referring domain / 2 backlinks — unchanged all month, 0 of 6 listings shipped❌ Not met
Human decisions closedcatalog.ts/Meta Ads status, persona-route scaffold, GSC submission requested0 of 3 — all still open; mailchimp's Aug ETA also lapsed this month❌ Not met
Leads/CPL proxyStays "pending" by designPending — GA4 unqueryable from this sandbox✅ As designed
Pages shipped (quality bar ~2/wk)~8–9 over the month6 net-new pages/posts + 3 correctness/depth sessions on live pages = 9 build-gated sessions✅ On pace
Domain Trustn/a (directional signal)4 → 5🟢 Small positive movement

Score — Month 2 goal: Missed (0 of 4 measurable KPIs met)

Content execution stayed strong for a second straight month — on pace, zero regressions, two real bugs caught and fixed from live evidence rather than guesswork. But every metric this routine doesn't fully control — rankings, off-page links, the three human-decision blockers — is exactly where the month came up empty, and unlike Month 1 (partial credit for wiring up rank tracking itself), there was no equivalent "turned out to be self-serve after all" discovery this month: off-page listings and GSC submission both genuinely require a human with a browser, and this sandbox has no outbound HTTP to do either. Zero rank movement in month 2 of a 6–12 month ramp isn't in itself alarming for a DA-0 domain competing on KD 11–38 terms — but a flat-zero referring-domain count for two full months, on a plan whose own thesis leans on off-page listings to build early trust, is the piece most worth a human's attention now, not a future session's.

Adjustments for next month

  • Escalating rather than re-logging: off-page Phase 1 (6 directory/registry listings, ~15–30 min each, all self-serve web forms) and GSC sitemap submission are the two highest-leverage, lowest-effort items on the entire plan and both are 100% blocked on human access this sandbox doesn't have — flagging both explicitly in this report's subject line context rather than only in the worklog NEXT list, where they've sat unactioned for 4+ and 8+ weekly entries respectively.
  • catalog.ts needs one human pass across all 5 overdue entries (meta_ads, shopify, hubspot, mailerlite, mailchimp) to mark each either genuinely shipping soon (new ETA) or live/soft-launched (unblocks a new connector-matrix page) — re-checking it every session without a human update is now pure overhead.
  • With the connector matrix and comparison hub both still fully caught up, September should shift toward the 12-week-strategy.md Week 9–11 items that don't depend on catalog.ts: long-tail connector variants (ChatGPT-assistant column, pending the still-open human check from 2026-08-06) and a claude mcp server pillar page (810/mo+ and climbing, never given its own dedicated page despite being the single highest-volume term in the whole thesis).
  • September 2026 lands at the end of the original 12-week window (kickoff 2026-07-04 + 12 weeks ≈ 2026-09-26) — the next monthly report should do the full W12 review: score months 1–3 together, refresh the keyword map with a live SE Ranking pull, and decide whether the goal metric flips toward leads or the ramp genuinely needs more runway given zero rankings through month 2.

Goal — Month 3 (September 2026)

1) First measured SERP position for any of the 22 tracked keywords (de-escalated from Month 2's ≥15 — a domain with zero ranked keywords after 2 full months needs to clear this lower bar before a top-50 target means anything). 2) Off-page Phase 1 shipped — even 2–3 of the 6 directory/registry listings would be the first referring-domain movement since kickoff; flagged to a human as the single highest-leverage open item. 3) Human decisions closed on catalog.ts (now 5 of 5 gated connectors overdue) and the persona-route scaffold, and GSC submission actually completed, not just requested. 4) Continue quality content pace into the plan's W9–W11 items — long-tail connector variants and a claude mcp server pillar page — now that the core connector matrix and comparison hub are caught up. 5) Leads/CPL proxy stays "pending" through Month 3 unless rankings actually appear; if they do, start pulling GA4 conversions as the real goal metric per the strategy doc's own W12 instruction.

Full detail: docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (this entry appended to top) · SE Ranking project id 12704162.
